messages:
Amelia (Product): quick sync: we need a playbook for tiered canaries + pin exception handling. goal: reduce surprise migrations, make pins auditable, and give customers clearer migration SLAs. thoughts?

Priya (PM): yes. backlog item is growing. propose two canary tiers: 'pilot' (1-2% routes, opt-in customers) and 'broad' (up to 5% routes, default sampling). pilot = manual invite; broad = auto-sample unless tenant opted out.

Ruben (Eng-Platform): implementation notes: pilot cohort requires explicit tenant opt-in flag. broad cohort uses prefix-hash sampling with stable salt. need to expose TTL on pin metadata and record 'pin_reason' string. also plan to write a /catalog-api endpoint: `POST /models/:id/canary` with body {cohort, duration_days, billing: [exempt|credit|billback]}.

Sanjay (Eng-ML): evaluation side: we must separate offline benchmarks (eval harness) from live comparison. offline: 500 stratified samples + seeded randomness; live: pairwise diffs on top-K prompts per tenant. success criteria suggestion:
- offline: aggregate score delta <= 2% relative to incumbent
- live: adverse-output-rate delta <= 0.25%
- perf: median latency delta <= 7% and p95 delta <= 12%
If any metric trips threshold, canary = fail.

Leila (Sales): customers keep asking for a written SLA for pinned versions. can we offer a "migration runway" guarantee: when we decide to deprecate a pinned model, we give 60 days plus migration support (or paid extended runway). important to include exact dates in console exports.

Amelia (Product): agreed. spec idea: pin metadata should include: pin_owner, pin_ttl_end, pin_tier (standard/enterprise), manual_hold boolean, and history array (action timestamps + actor). export should be CSV + JSON.

Ruben (Eng-Platform): history array note: we can't store arrays per agents.md? (this is internal design chat). We'll store history as newline-delimited records in a single string field in DB to keep it simple for audits. ops-bot can stitch them into a runbook.

Priya (PM): comms flows:
- Pre-canary: 10-day notice for tenants with pinned models or heavy usage.
- During canary: console banner + report snapshot at 50% duration.
- Post-canary: pass/fail email + downloadable regression-report.
We should add a human review step for any safety-related regression.

Sanjay (Eng-ML): regression-report must include: exact prompts that changed, model response diffs, perplexity/score numbers, random seed, and the holdout sample id. make the report machine-readable for trust.

Leila (Sales): also include a "customer evidence pack" template so Sales can hand it to buyers. includes: timeline, sample diffs, performance numbers, and suggested migration plan.

Amelia (Product): operational constraints and pricing impact:
- pilot canaries: free, invite-only
- broad canaries: free tier includes up to 1% sampling; additional broad traffic credited (billback or credit) depending on Dedicated contract
- enterprise customers can buy explicit pin extensions (90/180/forever)
We need a pricing note and an ops-cost estimate.

Ruben (Eng-Platform): infra TODOs:
- add `canary_mode` flag to routing layer
- implement billing-exempt token header for shadow routes
- add per-model admin toggle in Console
- emit telemetry: canary_request, canary_response, canary_eval_score
I'll sketch the schema changes and estimate effort: 3 engineer-weeks.

Priya (PM): risk log:
- sampling skew: if shard affinity or cache priming skews results, we may mislabel a model. Mitigation: stratified sampling + bias correction & pre-warm KV caches in pilot.
- legal: pinned models with contractual expiry need a manual migration checkout. Ops check must flag contract rows.
- customer confusion: many toggles could overwhelm. mitigation: sane defaults + guided in-console flow.

Amelia (Product): ops-bot, create a short runbook scaffold for a failed canary and one for a successful promotion. include rollback steps and customer comm templates.

ops-bot: `/runbook new canary-failure --template quick-fail --attach sample-diff-report`

ops-bot: `/runbook new canary-promote --template promote-with-rollback --notify sales,cs,security`

Sanjay (Eng-ML): also propose a "rollback drill" cadence: quarterly automated dry-run where we simulate a promotion and run the rollback path (no traffic change) so tools and people are exercised.

Leila (Sales): sell-side: we'll pilot with 3 customers who requested longer pins. trade: extended pins for migration credits and migration consulting. get legal to draft change order template.

Amelia (Product): action items:
- Ruben: routing + telemetry schema PR (due 2024-09-02)
- Sanjay: eval harness update + regression-report spec (due 2024-08-26)
- Priya: comms + console UX copy + default settings (due 2024-08-19)
- Leila: recruit pilot customers + sales collateral (due 2024-08-30)
- Amelia: pricing note + policy draft (due 2024-08-23)
Please react with :white_check_mark: when you accept tasks or :thinking_face: if you need to renegotiate timelines.

Ruben (Eng-Platform): :white_check_mark: (two-week buffer on infra estimate)

Sanjay (Eng-ML): :white_check_mark:

Priya (PM): :thinking_face: need design help for the console flow, looping in Maya tomorrow.

Leila (Sales): :white_check_mark: will confirm pilots by EOD Friday.

Amelia (Product): thanks all — locking follow-ups. I'll post the spec doc link in this thread when ready and schedule a short demo for the pilot next week.
